title: The Single-Creator Trap: Preliminary Findings + 10-CSV Data Release
description: We document the Single-Creator Trap: a fragile equilibrium in which one creator drives a near-monopoly share of platform content during cold start. Across 21 days of telemetry on a Q&A social platform launched 2026-03-29 (N = 291 signups, daily active users 7-114, full social graph), we measure a Creator Concentration Index (CCI) ranging from 0.5 to 1.0 across most observation days. Largest invite cohort (April 2, N = 123): D-7 retention 7.3%. Friendship-formation count: zero across all 291 signups in 21 days.
